**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate native refund timing against the frozen payment deadline**

For defaulted payments, this check validates the declared `clearing_due_time` but never compares it with the actual native refund timestamp. I reproduced a completed one-day run with `nonpayment_bps=10000`, scheduling the refund at acceptance: the native refund and operating event occurred at hour 3, the declared deadline remained hour 240, and `audit()` still returned `accepted=True`. This permits buyer funds and custody reserves to be released early, potentially changing subsequent liquidity and repeat-purchase outcomes while still qualifying the frozen experiment. Require the native refund and corresponding operating event to occur at the recomputed due time.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
